answer: In the combined logistic regression of BMI, age, and gender on treatment response (PR vs non-PR), the Wald p-value for age is p = 0.0025 (~0.003). Age is a significant negative predictor: each additional year of age multiplies the odds of PR by 0.92 (OR ≈ 0.924, 95% CI 0.877–0.972). The result is robust to dichotomizing BMI at its median (sensitivity p = 0.0026).
